title: My House
text:
This is my house. It is small and blue. There is a big table in the kitchen. Four chairs are around the table.

My bedroom is upstairs. There is a bed, a desk and a lamp. The lamp is on the desk. I like my room very much.

questions.text: Where does the writer probably sleep?
What can we guess about the family?
options: They may eat together at the table

vocabulary.definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs, used for eating or working
on a higher floor of a house
a table used for writing or working
a light that you can move or turn on and off

paragraph_translations: To jest mój dom. Jest mały i niebieski. W kuchni jest duży stół. Wokół stołu stoją cztery krzesła.
Moja sypialnia jest na górze. Jest tam łóżko, biurko i lampa. Lampa stoi na biurku. Bardzo lubię mój pokój.
